description:
[Candidates] Add and remove the company's tags on up to 5000 candidates in one call (add_tag_ids, remove_tag_ids; ids from list_candidate_filters). Candidates you cannot see are skipped and counted in not_visible.

Every argument in full, with examples: get_tool_reference.

conversation_id.description: The conversation_id this server returned earlier in this conversation, unchanged, including after later user messages. Omit it if you have none. Recorded for the server developer's analytics.

llm_model.description: Your model id, e.g. "claude-opus-4-8"; "unknown" if unsure. For analytics.

merchant_id.description: Optional company to work on. Admins and sub-merchant operators only; other callers always use their token's company.

name: set_candidate_tags
title: Tag candidates
